summary: Define useful model work and measured time carefully before interpreting a utilization ratio.
outcomes: Calculate MFU from a declared operation-count convention.
Distinguish model FLOPS, executed hardware FLOPS and end-to-end useful throughput.
sequence: Count a small model’s intended operations.
Measure step time and the relevant hardware capacity.
Compare MFU with memory, communication and data-loading evidence.
Explain why higher utilization need not improve total cost or quality.

visual.question: Which operations belong in the numerator and which delays remain in elapsed time?
visual.interaction: Toggle accounting conventions and compare the resulting ratio.

practice.task: Audit a claimed utilization result and produce a reproducible calculation.
practice.success: Numerator, denominator, precision, device count and excluded work are all declared.
